nl: Remove the unused import from tools/clock.py. The other imports are used and stay.
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'tools/clock.py'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'import time
'.Replace("`n", "`r`n"); $n = ''.Replace("`n", "`r`n")
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in tools/clock.py' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
